text:
minji: Quick report from canary q8 bring-up (nova-v1@2026-03-10, q8_kernel_opt). Seeing ZWJ (U+200D) disappear in vertical/furigana detokenization paths. Repro below.

raj: paste minimal repro + which runtime flags used?

minji: yep. sample: 
```
INPUT: あ漢字かな  # Han + ZWJ + Kana (intent: ruby join)

float32 output: あ\u200d漢字\u200dかな
q8 output:     あ漢字かな  # missing ZWJ between Han+Kana
```

minji: ran a quick eval on our furigana set: float32 BLEU=33.9, q8 BLEU=29.7 (delta -4.2). ~11% of samples show ZWJ missing under q8.

sophia: any differences in tokenizer/detok flags? we added preserve_zwj recently but runtime might default false on some codepaths.

minji: looked at logs. token ids before model: [14222, 1, 9871]  (1 is ZWJ). q8 canary runtime snippet: 
```
runtime.conf: pack_kv=true
             strip_zero_width=true  # <- suspicious
kernel: fast_pack_v2 (q8)
```
float run had strip_zero_width=false, pack_kv=false.

kevin: that strip_zero_width toggle during packing is a red flag. fast_pack_v2 was optimized for memory but might normalize unicode during compression. I'll bisect kernel commits.

raj: can we capture token-level traces spanning tokenizer -> model -> pack -> unpack -> detok? need to know exactly where the 0x200D vanishes.

minji: I attached a trace to INF-5577. triage-bot created it: "INF-5577: q8 pack path drops ZWJ in vertical detok".

triage-bot: INF-5577 created and assigned to kevin. Priority: P2.

kevin: starting local repro with q8 emu (cpu) and an instrumented runtime. If we see ZWJ present pre-pack and missing post-unpack, packing layer is at fault. If it's present post-unpack but gone after detok, detok config is suspect.

minji: FYI q4a staging also shows regression but less frequent (~4%). suggests q8 kernel path more aggressive.

raj: mitigation idea: for CJK locales (ja, zh, ko) temporarily force strip_zero_width=false in canary config until root cause fixed. Might cost RAM/perf but avoids user regressions.

sophia: agreed. add kernel team to INF-5577 and run perf regression if disabling fast_pack_v2. we need an estimate of latency/memory tradeoffs.

kevin: will bisect and post offending commit. if it's a unicode normalization introduced in packer, revert or gate it by locale.

minji: added per-sample diffs + BLEU table to the ticket. also opened small PR to keep preserve_zwj=true for CJK locales while we triage.

raj: run full furigana testset with `python eval/run_furigana_diff.py --model nova-v1 --quant q8 --out /tmp/q8-furi.csv` and upload artifacts to INF-5577.

minji: done, artifacts linked. will monitor canary after PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:

kevin: update: found commit 9f8d7e that introduced unicode_normalize in fast_pack_v2. I'll try reverting locally and running the furigana suite.

sophia: if revert shows no perf cliff, we can ship revert quickly. otherwise we'll gate normalization by a new flag `pack_unicode_normalize` and set false for CJK by default.

minji: ping here when revert/gate is merged. triage-bot: mark INF-5577 watched-by: eng-ml, eng-runtime, eng-ml-kernel."
